pick: Baltimore Ravens moneyline vs Tennessee Titans
confidence_note: High chance this leg hits, not a betting edge: the market already prices Baltimore at roughly 85% to win. Safe leg, very little payout.
reasoning: Parlay-leg pick chosen to maximize hit probability: Titans have scored 37 points in 3 games, Lamar Jackson reported healthy, all 5 NFL.com analysts pick BAL. Market already prices ~85% win chance, so this is safety, not an edge.
why: Tennessee has scored 37 points in 3 games (0-3); only Miami and New England have scored fewer (Squawka).
Lamar Jackson is reported healthy, in "peak condition" per the Ravens, after going 15/20 with 2 TDs in Week 3 (Ravens.com).
Baltimore runs for 5.2 yards a carry; Tennessee has already allowed 379 rushing yards (Squawka).
All 5 NFL.com analysts pick Baltimore; even Covers, taking Tennessee +11.5, expects the Ravens to win.
breaks: A Lamar Jackson in-game injury forcing a backup to hold the lead. Two Ravens starters, OT Ronnie Stanley and WR Zay Flowers, are questionable.
runner_up: Packers -3.5 (+100): Tampa Bay starts undrafted rookie QB Jalon Daniels, but it's a coin-flip market and Green Bay's interior O-line is banged up.
